summary: API key rotation for a service account causes all paused schedules to become active instead of remaining paused. After creating a new API key, previously paused schedules resume running after 2-3 minutes.
userImpact: When rotating API keys for a service account, previously paused schedules unexpectedly resume execution, potentially causing unintended workflow executions.
keyQuote: All paused schedules are now in `Running` state
